issues_detected.description: Release datasets carry no keywords; discovery terms exist only at collection level, which is not inherited.

issues_detected.description: No release states regulatory/confidentiality status, governance contact, human-subjects status, deidentification, privacy or sensitivity; these appear only at collection level. With no caller context these items remain applicable.

issues_detected.description: No release documents consent (e.g. for donor-derived iPSC lines), at-risk populations, compensation, ethical review or downstream social impact.

issues_detected.description: The record has no Dataset/DatasetCollection declaration and four resources, so it is scored as a collection of four release datasets with minimum-per-item aggregation. Its rich top-level documentation (purposes, funders with OT2OD032742/U54HG012513 awards, governance, limitations, RO-Crate conformance, collection mechanisms) is not inherited, which is the main driver of the low score.
issues_detected.recommendation: Declare the top-level class (Dataset or DatasetCollection) so the intended scoring scope is explicit.

issues_detected.description: Each release's page-header version (1.4, 2.1, 2.1, 2.0) differs from the citation's V1/V2 label, and the June 2026 release date conflicts with a 'Released on: June 17, 2025' display; the record discloses both discrepancies in source_caveats.
issues_detected.recommendation: Reconcile version labels with Dataverse citation versions where possible.

issues_detected.description: Protein counts for IF images differ by release (563, 464) and from the collection page (523); the record discloses this rather than reconciling it.
issues_detected.recommendation: State which protein count applies to which release snapshot.

issues_detected.description: At collection level, human_subject_research.involves_human_subjects is false while samples are described as de-identified human cell lines; consistent, but is_deidentified gives no method beyond 'cannot be matched to a human subject'. Not scored because collection metadata is not inherited.
issues_detected.recommendation: State the deidentification basis (commercial cell lines, no linkage) explicitly as a method.

semantic_insights: Scored as an undeclared collection of four Dataverse releases; item score is the minimum across releases, and collection-level fields are not inherited.
The June 2026 (current) release is the thinnest unit: archive names, MD5s and a file count, with no per-file descriptions; it sets the minimum on E5.2, E6.5 and E8.1.
Identifiers, licence, citation, formats and version labels are consistently strong in every release.
The collection-level documentation (purposes, NIH OT2OD032742 funding, governance contact, limitations, RO-Crate conformance) is substantially richer than any release unit.
